facts.business: Munoth Financial Services Limited is a financial services company engaged in capital markets activities including investments, loans and advances, and trade receivables management.

guidance_or_targets.statement: outlook of Indian capital markets are positive and the company do not foresee any risk which can not be mitigated

key_risks: Credit risk from investments, trade receivables, loans and advances, and cash equivalents
Concentration of credit risk in financial instruments amounting to Rs 29,754.38 thousands
Default risk when counterparty fails to make contractual payments within 60 days
Significant increase in credit risk presumed when payments are more than 30 days past due
facts.related_party_note: Directors have inter-se relationships: Mr. Lalchand Munoth is father of Mr. Vikas Munoth, Mr. Bharat Munoth, and Mr. Jaswant Munoth; Mr. Vikas Munoth, Mr. Bharat Munoth, and Mr. Jaswant Munoth are brothers. Mr. Vikas Munoth holds directorships in Munoth Communication Limited, Munoth Lithium Battery Private Limited, Munoth Industries Limited, and Tirupati Electronics Manufacturing Cluster Limited. Mr. Lalchand Munoth holds directorships in Misrimal Navajee Estates Private Limited, Munoth Industries Limited, Munoth Bioscience Limited, and South India Chemicals and Leasing Private Limited.
